entities.name: Tewodros I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Tewodros I, throne name Walda Anbasa was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1413 to 1414, and 
a member of the Solomonic dynasty. He was the son of Dawit I by Queen Seyon Mangasha.
